scope: Four bounded CPU Gaussian covariance/mixed-model operations covering nine repeated covariance families;partial JMP19.2 numerical coverage.
integration_status: Parent public execute routes enabled;16focusedtests pass. NativeSQL validation is owned by parent.

common_contract.matrix: Finite nonempty rectangular numeric data<=100000rows,1024columns,1000000cells; fitting further capped256rows/16fixednumericfeatures. Exact signed subject IDs<=2^53-1.
common_contract.time_semantics: Parameters refer to sorted global time levels. AR1 covariance=variance*rho^abs(actual_elapsed_time);negative rho requires integral gaps. Toeplitz requires uniform global grid and uses lag in grid increments;missing visits retain global lag. Antedependence multiplies all intervening global adjacent correlations,including omitted visits. Other heterogeneity parameters are categorical by ordered level.
common_contract.SPD: Variances>0;correlations strictly(-1,1);CS rho>-1/(m-1);all matrices SPD at relative per-diagonal Cholesky pivot1e-12. No pseudoinverse. Full-rank whitened design relative QR threshold1e-11.
common_contract.likelihood: Exact Gaussian conditional/profile likelihood;REML includes original-design determinant,so response and feature rescaling affects restricted likelihood by the mathematically required constants. AIC/BIC counts fixed coefficients plus covariance parameters;REML comparisons require identical fixed designs. Known-covariance method2 AIC/BIC=null.
common_contract.uncertainty: coefficient_covariance/SE conditional on covariance estimate only;covariance parameter SE/CI/tests not supplied. Local profile Hessian is an identification diagnostic only. covariance_parameters_identified=false or boundary causes converged=false. optimizer_converged separately reports solver result.
common_contract.covariance_boundary: Search coordinate abs>24.9 (repeated coordinate cap25),relative variance<=1e-12,relative conditional pivot<=1e-8,or random G determinant/diagonal<=1e-8 criteria. These numerical boundary diagnostics do not provide boundary-mixture tests.
common_contract.fit_limits: Max30000likelihood evaluations and1000000000nominal blockdense work units;line search<=40trials;max1000iterations. Repeated covariance<=8levels,unstructured<=36covariance parameters. Numerical failure/invalid input/work exhaustion errors explicitly.
common_contract.saved_model: [p,response_origin,response_mean_offset,response_population_scale,standardized_intercept,feature_origins(p),feature_mean_offsets(p),feature_population_scales(p),standardized_fixed_slopes(p),n_subjects,(subject_id,normalized_intercept_BLUP,normalized_slope_BLUP)*n_subjects]. Here p includes the auto fixed slope;last fixed feature is the random slope covariate.
common_contract.outputs: coefficients ordered intercept,other fixed slopes,auto slope;standard_errors same order. fitted_values are marginal fixed-effect means. conditional_fitted_values add BLUPs. blups columns are original-unit random intercept and raw-slope coefficient. covariance_parameters uses physical layouts above.

operations.description: Nine repeated covariance matrices: scalar increasing times; [structure_code, physical parameters...].
operations.data: 2..64 scalar strictly increasing global time levels.
args: complete physical covariance parameters for the selected code
operations.estimator: Direct documented variance/correlation formulas; Cholesky verifies SPD with pivots relative to each original diagonal.

operations.description: Gaussian repeated measures: [features...,y,subject,time]; [structure,method=1,maxiter=300,tolerance=1e-8,known covariance if method2].
operations.data: 0..16 numeric fixed features followed by response, exact integer subject id, actual time. Intercept is automatic. <=256 rows,2..8 global levels,unique subject/time,>=2 subjects and within-subject replication.
args: tolerance1e-12..1e-3,default1e-8; gradient norm convergence sqrt(tolerance) clamped[1e-7,1e-5]
method2 only: complete physical covariance parameters; method0/1 prohibit extra values
operations.estimator: Independent-subject Gaussian likelihood. Subject-block Cholesky whitening and Householder QR compute GLS. ML profiles scale with n;REML with n-p and original-design determinant correction. Shape uses SPD Cholesky/PACF/partial-correlation coordinates and finite-difference BFGS. Method2 uses the supplied covariance without estimating a residual scale. Coefficient covariance conditions on estimated covariance parameters; no small-sample correction. Hessian of profile objective diagnoses local identification. Unconverged/boundary/unidentified solutions are explicit flags,never converged=true.
unsupported: simultaneous random G-side plus structured R-side model
likelihood comparison of REML models with different fixed designs

operations.data: 0..15 other numeric features followed by numeric slope covariate,response,exact integer subject id. Intercept and slope are included as fixed and correlated random effects. <=256 rows,<=16 total fixed numeric features,>=3 subjects,within-subject replication.
args: tolerance1e-12..1e-3,default1e-8; gradient norm convergence sqrt(tolerance) clamped[1e-7,1e-5]
operations.estimator: Gaussian marginal covariance sigma2 I + Z G Z^T with positive-semidefinite 2x2 G from a free lower factor. True profile ML/REML,origin-relative numerical standardization,conditional GLS covariance,group BLUPs G Z^T V^-1 residual. Random covariance/BLUPs reported for original raw slope units; portable model retains normalized coordinates. Boundary singular G returns variance_boundary=true and converged=false,even if optimizer converged.
unsupported: structured residual covariance jointly with G
covariance-parameter SE/CI/tests or small-sample df corrections

operations.description: Saved random slope prediction: [other_features...,slope,subject]; exact returned predict_parameters.
operations.data: Same fixed features/slope order as training,followed by exact integer subject id. Finite rectangular matrix<=100000 rows/1000000 cells.
args: exact predict_parameters from random_slope_model; layout in common_contract
operations.estimator: Reuses training feature/response references. Known subjects receive stored normalized random intercept+slope BLUPs;unknown subjects receive zero random effects. Returns conditional predictions,marginal predictions,and known_subjects flags.
